title: Idle Survivor Games on Android: What the Genre Is and Why
subtitle: Swarm survivors and idle games share a lot of DNA. Here is how they combine, and what to look for.
description: Idle survivor games on Android explained: auto-firing weapons, level-up choices, an idle base and prestige. What the genre is and what to look for in one.
card: What an idle survivor game on Android is, how it differs from a classic swarm survivor, and what to check before you pick one to play.

faq.q: What is an idle survivor game?
faq.a: It combines a swarm survivor, where you dodge crowds while weapons fire automatically and you choose upgrades on each level-up, with an idle base that earns resources over time, even when the game is closed.

faq.q: Are idle survivor games pay to win?
faq.a: It depends on the game. Look for optional rewarded ads, a Remove Ads option and purchases that only save time. In Void Swarm, nothing is required to progress, and no ad interrupts a run.

faq.q: How long is a session in an idle survivor game?
faq.a: Usually short. In Void Swarm a run lasts about ten minutes and ends with a boss, and the idle base keeps earning between sessions, so a quick visit still counts for something.
